title: Phase 2 Study of MD-1100 Acetate Administered for 14 Days to Patients Meeting Criteria for Chronic Constipation
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and gastrointestinal pharmacodynamics (stool frequency, stool consistency, stool ease of passage, stool completeness of evacuation) of MD-1100 acetate administered daily for 14 days.
